mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a simple guest room and a full guest apartment?

acceptedAnswer.text: A standalone guest bedroom is simply an extra sleeping room within your primary home's existing floor plan, typically sharing a hallway bathroom and common areas with the rest of the household. A guest apartment, in contrast, is an independent living environment featuring its own private bathroom, living area, and often food-prep capabilities or an independent entrance. You should choose a guest apartment when housing guests for weeks or months at a time, accommodating aging relatives, or when you want to preserve daily privacy and quiet inside your main home.
acceptedAnswer.description: A guest room is an interior bedroom sharing existing household facilities. A guest apartment includes a private bathroom, living space, and independent access for extended stays.
